episodes.synopsis: The adventures of an easygoing boy on a sidereal megastructure in the distant future.
episodes.title: Something's Different About Today

episodes.synopsis: Banjo Ueki Tylor and Yamamoto 372 successfully rescue Goza the 168th from falling into a space-time fault. She then requests their aid in finding an interstellar rocket so she can travel to the center of the galaxy.
episodes.title: Today's a Super Hot Day

episodes.synopsis: The crew sets off in search of rocket fuel for their interstellar rocket.
episodes.title: This Is Here Today

episodes.synopsis: The crew falls into a dangerous trap in the desert.
episodes.title: I'm Sleepy All Day Again Today

episodes.synopsis: A robot cyborg in a sailor suit causes a minute and a half monologue.
episodes.title: Today Will Be a Quick One

episodes.synopsis: The story of the original heroic captain Taylor is recounted.
episodes.title: It Had to Be Today, Didn't It?

episodes.synopsis: A ghost is encountered at the middle of the crossroads. He's waiting for the devil to teach him to play music.
episodes.title: Today's About to Get Better

episodes.synopsis: The fuel to leave the Sidereal Megastructure has been purchased, and the crew is on its way. But first they must face a new foe.
episodes.title: This Is the Last Day We Do This Stuff

episodes.synopsis: Tylor reflects on his past as the ship leaves the Sidereal Megastructure, and says farewell to Yamamoto.
episodes.title: From now on, Days Will Be Like This

episodes.synopsis: After being caught in the gravity well the ship crashes. This time they land next to a giant castle of glass.
episodes.title: Today's Definitely a Different Day

episodes.synopsis: Yashioma and his forces launch a final attack on Tylor, for reasons that are only known to himself.
episodes.title: Even Today Will Someday Be Yesterday

episodes.synopsis: The two Tylors are reunited and a new story begins for the galaxy.
episodes.title: Today Is The One Special Day
